messages:
anya: Starting a short sync on the console/analytics envelope schema migration. Goals: no console regressions, fast safe rollback, and minimal index churn.
rohan: plan at a glance?
anya: dual-write -> shadow projection (compact table) -> staged canary. Need explicit gates for quota routing metrics and dashboard p99s.
mike: On dual-write we should tag events with `ingest_version='v2-envelope-2024'` and `route_hash` for deterministic diffing. Shadow worker will populate `ingest_projection(route_id, day, v2_count, v1_count, p50_ms, p95_ms)` to keep reads light. Add TTL to projection.
jess: Console: show a small badge when results are from shadow/projection and keep the read-mode toggle behind a feature-flag. Also include a step to ping #support-alerts at 20% canary.
eva: Telemetry plan: emit `mismatch_ratio` and `ingest_migration_toggle` events. Start deterministic sampling: `hash(route_id)%100 < 2` but always include routes with daily_count < 500. Also log full diffs for ~50 random routes/day for manual inspection.
rohan: Canary proposal: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h. Abort criteria: mismatch_ratio > 0.02 for routes with >1000 events/day OR console query p95_new/p95_old > 1.25.
mike: To protect query perf maintain the compact projection and add an index: `CREATE INDEX ix_ingest_proj_route_day ON ingest_projection(route_id, day);` Keep projection columns narrow and TTL old rows to avoid bloat.
anya: Rollback runbook should include exact toggles. Example SQL: `UPDATE feature_flags SET value='v1-only' WHERE key='console.ingest.read_mode';` and admin API: `POST /admin/feature-toggle/console-ingest?mode=v1-only`. Also telemetry on toggle: `telemetry('ingest_migration_toggle',{from:'v2',to:'v1',actor:current_user})`.
rohan: Add a safepoint export step before cutover: snapshot routing join keys and small routing metadata export to speed reconciliation. Suggest: `pg_dump --table=routing_keys --data-only --file=safepoint_routing_$(date +%s).sql`.
jess: (typo)
jess: I'll build the dashboard card: v1_count, v2_count, mismatch_ratio, p50/p95 delta and make it a canary gate chart.
mike: I'll prototype the projection DDL and add the index DDL and sample compact reconciliation query to the runbook. Example recon SQL: `SELECT route_id, sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end) v1, sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then 1 else 0 end) v2 FROM ingestion_events WHERE day = current_date - 1 GROUP BY route_id HAVING greatest(sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then 1 else 0 end)) > 10;`
eva: I'll own metrics + sampling config and push telemetry events.
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write cron will start at 2024-05-03T02:00Z if feature flags are enabled :gear:
anya: I'll author the runbook PR, assign owners (Mike projection, Jess UI, Eva telemetry, Rohan rollout) and coordinate canary windows with eng-sre. Planning to enable dual-write Tue AM if no objections.
rohan: small nit: add step to notify product and support on canary start and on 20% escalation.
jess: added to checklist in PR draft.
anya: Thanks all. Filing PR now and will link it here. Closing thread.
